name: When should I repair my deck versus replacing it entirely?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair my deck versus replacing it entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace your deck depends on the extent of the damage and the overall condition of its structure. If only a few boards are rotted, railings are loose, or there are minor surface issues, repair is usually the more cost-effective option. However, if the deck's foundation is compromised, there's widespread rot, significant structural damage, or the cost of repairs approaches that of a new deck, replacement might be a better long-term investment. A professional assessment can help you make the best decision for your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair when damage is minor and localized; replace when there's widespread rot, structural issues, or repair costs are too high.
